parts.refutation: Ambient range: the pass is not shown by the data sheet. SLVSI72A gives TJ -40 to 125 degC (5.2) and RthJA 47.6 degC/W standard, 33 degC/W on the EVM (5.3), but no junction temperature or IC loss at 50 degC ambient. Derived from typical figures only (Figure 5-3, 25 degC): the VIN 5 V curve's end point, 88.8 % at 3.8 A and 9 V out, is 4.3 W of loss. Taking out at most about 0.85 W in TI's XAL7070 inductor (7.7 A input, 14.3 mOhm max) leaves about 3.4 W in the IC. At 33 degC/W that is about a 113 degC rise, so the junction would be above 125 degC at 50 degC ambient on the pack path at the 4.0 A load. These are typical values, not limits, so the pass is unproven. The fixed input is reported to the owner, not re-selected.
